subject: reduce header row space in renderDataTable

messages.author: 5d5a6103d3120fa5
messages.subject: reduce header row space in renderDataTable
parts:
I have a few tables in a shiny app that I have developed..
www.wittgensteincentre.org/dataexplorer
where I have only one row (see for example the first table in the data tab or all tables in the glossary tab)

It made sense to drop the filter, search and other features that usually display at the top of the table using the following options in renderDataTable ..
list(bFilter = FALSE, bAutoWidth =FALSE, bInfo=FALSE, bPaginate=FALSE)
however this leaves me with a bit of a white space above the table, I guess from the empty row above the header or the header row itself. Either way I can not figure out how to eliminate the white space? I have looked around http://datatables.net but to no avail.

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: reduce header row space in renderDataTable
parts:
I do not know why the page length menu is still there after you set
bPaginate=FALSE. Perhaps you were using an old version of shiny.
Please try to update.packages() if your shiny version is < 0.10.1.

Anyway, now we are moving to the new DataTables 1.10.x:
https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/shiny-discuss/-0u-wTnq_lA In
this version, I think bPaginate=FALSE should be paging=FALSE.

Regards,
Yihui
